title: SAM3RL: Memory Control via Reinforcement Learning for Visual Object Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2610.19931v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) is a foundation model for image and video segmentation that sets the state of the art in visual object tracking. Its tracker, inherited from SAM 2, stores information from past frames in a memory bank, managed by a simple First-In-First-Out rule, allowing temporal consistency in complex videos. Several recent methods improve SAM 2 with hand-crafted memory update rules, each targeting a specific failure mode, such as distractors, occlusions, or object motion. However, their gains transfer only partially to the stronger SAM 3 backbone. We instead present a more general, data-driven approach that frames memory control as a sequential decision-making task. SAM3RL is an extension of the SAM 3 tracker with a lightweight memory controller, trained by reinforcement learning, that decides which frames enter the memory bank in order to maximize tracking performance. SAM3RL sets a new state of the art on 10 of 12

translated_title: SAM3RL：基于强化学习的视觉目标跟踪记忆控制
translated_abstract: Segment Anything Model 3（SAM 3）是一个用于图像和视频分割的基础模型，在视觉目标跟踪方面达到了最先进的水平。其跟踪器继承自 SAM 2，将过去帧的信息存储在一个记忆库中，由简单的先进先出（FIFO）规则进行管理，从而在复杂视频中保持时间一致性。近期的一些方法通过手工设计的记忆更新规则来改进 SAM 2，每种方法都针对特定的失败模式，例如干扰物、遮挡或物体运动。然而，这些方法带来的提升只能部分迁移到更强大的 SAM 3 主干网络上。为此，我们提出了一种更通用、数据驱动的方法，将记忆控制形式化为一个序贯决策任务。SAM3RL 是 SAM 3 跟踪器的扩展，配备了一个通过强化学习训练的轻量级记忆控制器，由它决定哪些帧进入记忆库，以最大化跟踪性能。SAM3RL 在 12 个基准中的 10 个上创造了新的最先进纪录。
tldr: SAM3RL 将 SAM 3 跟踪器的记忆控制形式化为序贯决策任务，通过强化学习训练轻量级记忆控制器来决定哪些帧进入记忆库，从而在 12 个基准中的 10 个上创造了新的最先进纪录。
en_tdlr: SAM3RL frames memory control in the SAM 3 tracker as a sequential decision-making task, training a lightweight memory controller via reinforcement learning to decide which frames enter the memory bank, achieving new state-of-the-art performance on 10 of 12 benchmarks.
